name: 27576 · Selma, NC
findings: ZIP 27576 (Selma) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27576 (Selma) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
